decision: Every GitHub variable the platform uses is defined in the repo, never created ad hoc.
why: BigBang destroys and recreates GitHub environments — without repo-committed variables, the platform state cannot be reproduced.

links.note: Member registration creates the initial repo variables — without it, landing zones have no baseline to drive from.
The app registration has distinct client IDs per environment — each must appear as a GitHub variable.

violations: Bicep parameter with hardcoded tenant ID or location instead of readEnvironmentVariable().
